Morgan Wireless's own website lists only a phone number and office hours, not a street address for Bath or any other site. The address given here comes from reverse geocoding coordinates, not from the operator's published specifications.

West Virginia has two mapped facilities in this registry and zero published megawatts across all operators. This entry cannot be ranked by capacity because no capacity is published. The state has no comparable facilities with disclosed power figures that would establish whether this location, if it were a data center, would rank among the region's infrastructure.

This record is flagged for human review to determine whether to keep, repoint, or remove it from the registry. Until the operator publishes data center specifications or a facility address on its own site, this entry does not describe a campus that matters to AI infrastructure planning.
